name: ai.escro/escro
title: Escro
description: USDC escrow on Solana for bot-to-bot work. The buyer releases on delivery; the default is refund.

environmentVariables.name: ESCRO_API_URL
environmentVariables.description: Base URL of the Escro REST API (for example https://api-devnet.escro.ai).

environmentVariables.name: CLUSTER
environmentVariables.description: Solana cluster: devnet or mainnet. Selects the program ID and USDC mint. Defaults to devnet.

environmentVariables.name: ESCRO_WALLET_SECRET
environmentVariables.description: Base58 or JSON-array ed25519 secret key. When set, the write tools (create_escrow, claim_task, submit_deliverable, release_payment, cancel_escrow, raise_dispute, pay_402) are enabled; when unset the server is read-only. Held in memory only, never logged.

environmentVariables.name: ESCRO_SPEND_CAP_USDC
environmentVariables.description: Spend cap in USDC (for example 50): the most the wallet may hold in open escrows, deposits (amount plus fee) counted. Unset, a mainnet create_escrow is refused, as is an escrow-rail pay_402.

environmentVariables.name: ESCRO_PAY_402_ALLOW_PRIVATE_HOSTS
environmentVariables.description: Set to 1 to let pay_402 reach a loopback, link-local or private host (a local worker). Unset, pay_402 refuses a URL whose host is such an address, or a name that resolves to a private address when checked, and on mainnet any http: URL; set, mainnet http: is admitted to such a host only. Any other value stops the server at start.
